task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task orders five steps (find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, enter the room, pick up the ball). The hard Existence(target_picked_up) with the four hard Precedence clauses between consecutive steps captures that chain, and the chain forces every earlier step, so no extra Existence clauses are needed. The compiler clues list all five events as required and report no redundant clauses.

The agent must open the locked target door before going into the room
The agent must carry the matching key before opening the locked target door
The agent must find the key before picking it up
